name: ireze
description: A Discord-based gateway advertising manually claimed daily credits.
overview: The operator advertises 4,000,000 credits every 24 hours after completing a Work.ink task and signing in with Discord; its changelog also mentions a 2,000,000-credit welcome bonus. Credits are not necessarily tokens or dollars. Model names and upstream identity are unverified: the site says unknown IDs route to its default, so do not assume any claimed Claude model is authentic. No signup or inference was tested.
free_access: 4M credits per 24 hours after manual Work.ink task
Discord login required; no card advertised
Model identity, billing and stability unverified
notes: Base URL https://ireze.site/v1. Treat model names as routing labels, not proof of upstream identity; avoid sensitive data.
